youtube.title: Napoleon's army found the Rosetta Stone. Britain took it 🪨 #shorts
youtube.caption:
The Rosetta Stone: found by Napoleon's army, kept by the British Museum 🇫🇷🇬🇧

France or Britain? Pick a side 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: French soldiers in Napoleon's Egypt campaign found the Rosetta Stone in 1799. When the French army surrendered in 1801, the British took it, and it has been in the British Museum since 1802. In 1822 a Frenchman, Jean-François Champollion, used it to decode Egyptian hieroglyphs.
